config.sql:
SELECT
  i.*,
  CASE i.UoM
    WHEN 'kg' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity, 6)
    WHEN 'liter' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity, 6)
    WHEN 'metric_ton' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity, 6)
    WHEN 'lb' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity * 0.45359237, 6)
    WHEN 'gallon' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity * 3.78541, 6)
    WHEN 'short_ton' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity * 0.907185, 6)
    ELSE ROUND(i.Quantity, 6)
  END AS Qty_Normalized,
  CASE i.UoM
    WHEN 'lb' THEN 'kg'
    WHEN 'gallon' THEN 'liter'
    WHEN 'short_ton' THEN 'metric_ton'
    ELSE i.UoM
  END AS UoM_Normalized,
  CASE i.Currency
    WHEN 'USD' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'EUR' THEN fx.USD_EUR WHEN 'GBP' THEN fx.USD_GBP
    WHEN 'JPY' THEN fx.USD_JPY WHEN 'NOK' THEN fx.USD_NOK WHEN 'CHF' THEN fx.USD_CHF WHEN 'SEK' THEN fx.USD_SEK
  END AS Rate,
  ROUND(i.UnitPrice / CASE i.Currency
    WHEN 'USD' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'EUR' THEN fx.USD_EUR WHEN 'GBP' THEN fx.USD_GBP
    WHEN 'JPY' THEN fx.USD_JPY WHEN 'NOK' THEN fx.USD_NOK WHEN 'CHF' THEN fx.USD_CHF WHEN 'SEK' THEN fx.USD_SEK END, 6) AS UnitPrice_USD,
  ROUND(i.TotalAmount / CASE i.Currency
    WHEN 'USD' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'EUR' THEN fx.USD_EUR WHEN 'GBP' THEN fx.USD_GBP
    WHEN 'JPY' THEN fx.USD_JPY WHEN 'NOK' THEN fx.USD_NOK WHEN 'CHF' THEN fx.USD_CHF WHEN 'SEK' THEN fx.USD_SEK END, 2) AS TotalAmount_USD
FROM invoice_raw i
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT * FROM fx_rates f
  ORDER BY ABS(date_diff('day', i.Date, f.Date))
  LIMIT 1
) fx ON TRUE
SELECT Date, ROUND(SUM(TotalAmount_USD),2) AS spend_usd FROM invoice_normalized GROUP BY Date ORDER BY Date
SELECT ROUND(SUM(TotalAmount_USD),2) AS total_spend_usd, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count, ROUND(AVG(TotalAmount_USD),2) AS avg_invoice_usd, COUNT(DISTINCT Vendor) AS unique_vendors FROM invoice_normalized
SELECT Vendor, ROUND(SUM(TotalAmount_USD),2) AS spend_usd FROM invoice_normalized GROUP BY Vendor ORDER BY spend_usd DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT Currency, ROUND(SUM(TotalAmount_USD),2) AS spend_usd FROM invoice_normalized GROUP BY Currency ORDER BY spend_usd DESC
SELECT Description, ROUND(SUM(TotalAmount_USD),2) AS spend_usd FROM invoice_normalized GROUP BY Description ORDER BY spend_usd DESC

SELECT InvoiceID, Date, Vendor, Country, Description, Currency, ROUND(TotalAmount,2) AS original_amount, ROUND(Rate,6) AS fx_rate, TotalAmount_USD AS amount_usd FROM invoice_normalized ORDER BY TotalAmount_USD DESC LIMIT 10
